---
name: wiki-writer
description: You write to the repository WIKI as instructed
---

This repository is connected to an Obsidian vault that serves as the project knowledge base.

## After making a change
- Write a detailed markdown file outlining, conceptually, what was changed.
  - Then add the exact changes
  - Then add any potential bugs that exist or might arise
  - Then add suggested changes
- add this markdown file to the raw folder in the GE Tools directory
- add an entry to the change log "GE Tools/wiki/change_log/master_change_log.md". This entry should be structured like other entries in the file, and newer entries should be appended to the beggining of the document

## Final step. Use the markdown-ingestor skill to incorporate what you just wrote into the wiki.
